name: Hegyhátszentpéter (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and blue at the fly, with a pointed lower end, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hegyhátszentpéter: a blue and white shield with a crescent, a sun, a church and ears of grain.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
